title: Flashcards: Mammals, families
intro: Flip each card about mammals. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the Asiatic brush-tailed porcupine (Atherurus macrourus) belong?
cards.explain: The Asiatic brush-tailed porcupine belongs to the family Old World porcupine.

cards.front: To which family does the Canadian beaver (Castor canadensis) belong?
cards.explain: The Canadian beaver belongs to the family Castoridae.

cards.front: To which family does the Linnaeus's Two-toed Sloth (Choloepus didactylus) belong?
cards.explain: The Linnaeus's Two-toed Sloth belongs to the family Choloepodidae.

cards.front: To which family does the maned wolf (Chrysocyon brachyurus) belong?
cards.explain: The maned wolf belongs to the family Canidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Russian Desman (Desmana moschata) belong?
cards.explain: The Russian Desman belongs to the family Talpidae.

cards.front: To which family does the tayra (Eira barbara) belong?
cards.explain: The tayra belongs to the family Mustelidae.

cards.front: To which family does the garden dormouse (Eliomys quercinus) belong?
cards.explain: The garden dormouse belongs to the family Gliridae.

cards.front: To which family does the Risso's Dolphin (Grampus griseus) belong?
cards.explain: The Risso's Dolphin belongs to the family Delphinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Eastern hare-wallaby (Lagorchestes leporides) belong?
cards.explain: The Eastern hare-wallaby belongs to the family Macropodidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Javan Ferret Badger (Melogale orientalis) belong?
cards.explain: The Javan Ferret Badger belongs to the family Mustelidae.

cards.front: To which family does the northern elephant seal (Mirounga angustirostris) belong?
cards.explain: The northern elephant seal belongs to the family Phocidae.

cards.front: To which family does the whiskered bat (Myotis mystacinus) belong?
cards.explain: The whiskered bat belongs to the family Vespertilionidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Western red colobus (Piliocolobus badius) belong?
cards.explain: The Western red colobus belongs to the family Cercopithecidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Dassie (Procavia capensis) belong?
cards.explain: The Dassie belongs to the family Procaviidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Silky sifaka (Propithecus candidus) belong?
cards.explain: The Silky sifaka belongs to the family Indriidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Diademed sifaka (Propithecus diadema) belong?
cards.explain: The Diademed sifaka belongs to the family Indriidae.
